checkpoints.snapshot_summary: Colab startup stability improved; API is resilient to missing heavy deps and reduced resolver conflicts.
checkpoints.discoveries: Dependency minimization and lazy initialization are the highest-impact stability improvements for Colab runtime.
checkpoints.next_recommended_action: Implement T-003 routed HF LLM + RAG, keeping lazy-load patterns and optional extras split.

solutions: Unified blackboard protocol can coexist with project code by using a single source file UNIFIED_LOG.json as runtime memory.
Avoid eager heavy-model imports in API startup; lazy load + cache per-user pipeline engines.
patterns: Per-user isolated folders + anonymized global feedback stream supports privacy with shared model learning.
Use a minimal Colab requirements profile for serving APIs; install finetuning extras separately.
lessons_learned: Most Colab connection-refused incidents were process startup failures after dependency resolver downgrades.
architecture_decisions: Task sequencing: bootstrap state -> multi-user data plane -> routed LLM+RAG execution plane.

improvements.proposed_improvement: Move user/global persistence to PostgreSQL + vector DB with migration control
Integrate guardrails with risk labels and psychological safety policy checks
Add `/health/deep` endpoint that checks pipeline and DB readiness to debug startup quickly.
